title: 지도 앱 길 찾기: 몇 분 걸려요? 어디에서 내려요?
objective: You can read a Korean map app's route result and find the trip time, transfers, and where to get on, get off, and exit.
summary: Learners read a map app's route screen to find travel time, transfers, stops, and exits.
note: The screens on this sheet are made-up examples. Real map apps may use slightly different words.

task.title: Read the route screens
task.line: Read each part of the screen and write the word, letter, time, or number it asks for.

sections.heading: Words on the map app screen

items.text: The place you leave from; apps often fill in your location first.
The place you go to, and also the arrival time on a route card.
The tab for bus and subway routes.
The walking tab, or the walking time on a route.
Changing to another bus or subway line.
Shows the stop or station where you get on.
Shows the stop or station where you get off.
The numbered exit to use when you leave the subway station.

sections.heading: Finding a route: step by step
Reading a route card
paragraphs: A route card looks like this: 「34분 · 오후 2:10 도착 · 환승 1회 · 도보 9분」. 회 means 'times', so 환승 1회 means one transfer. 도보 9분 means you walk for 9 minutes in total.
Under the card, each line tells you where to go: 「새솔역 승차 → 6개 역 → 햇살역 하차 → 3번 출구」. Look for 승차 (get on), 하차 (get off), and the exit number.

exercises: Read the route card and write the answer as it appears on the screen. 「27분 · 오전 9:40 도착 · 환승 2회 · 도보 6분」: ① How long is the whole trip? ② What time do you arrive? ③ How many times do you transfer? ④ How long do you walk?
Fill in the blanks with 승차 or 하차: 푸른공원 정류장 ( ① ) → 4개 정류장 → 햇살시장 정류장 ( ② )
Compare the two routes and write A or B (A: 31분 · 환승 2회 · 도보 4분 / B: 35분 · 환승 0회 · 도보 7분): ① 더 빨리 가요. ② 환승이 없어요. ③ 도보 시간이 짧아요.
Read the guide and answer in Korean. 「바다역 하차 → 5번 출구 → 도보 4분 → 도착」: ① Where do you get off? ② Which exit do you use? ③ How long do you walk?
You are going from home to the library. Fill in the blanks with 출발 or 도착: ( ① ) 우리 집 → ( ② ) 미래도서관
answers: ① 27분 (27 minutes) ② 오전 9:40 ③ 2회 (2 times) ④ 6분 (6 minutes)
